description: This file contains functions and types for converting diffs of board/card objects into Slack attachments, including templates for notifications about card changes, and functions for rendering these templates with diff data.

classes.name: DiffConvOpts
classes.description: Options for converting diffs to Slack attachments, including language, link functions, and logger.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached text template based on name and language, used for notification formatting.

methods.name: makeAuthorsList
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated list of authors' names prefixed with '@'.

methods.name: execTemplate
methods.description: Executes a named template with provided data and writes output to an io.Writer.

methods.name: Diffs2SlackAttachments
methods.description: Converts a list of diffs into Slack attachments for notification purposes.

methods.name: cardDiff2SlackAttachment
methods.description: Creates a Slack attachment from a card diff, including change details and comments.

methods.name: appendTitleChanges
methods.description: Appends title change info to Slack attachment fields if the title has changed.

methods.name: appendPropertyChanges
methods.description: Appends property differences to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendCommentChanges
methods.description: Appends comment additions or deletions to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendAttachmentChanges
methods.description: Appends attachment add/remove info to Slack attachment fields.

methods.name: appendContentChanges
methods.description: Appends content/description changes to Slack attachment fields, including markdown diff.
